## Summary

This PR addresses all unresolved review threads from the two most-commented open PRs from the last 5 days.

### PR #94 — `design.md` (11 unresolved threads)

- **File header** — added required `Purpose / Why / Info flow` comment block
- **Colors** — aligned tokens with implementation: `#e8006a` (fuchsia primary), `#c9a227` (gold secondary), `#f0c44a` (tertiary), `#fdf6e3` (cream neutral-light), `#07070f` (neutral-dark), `#00c896` (emerald success), `#b8aacf` (lavender joy)
- **Typography** — replaced `system-ui` with actual loaded fonts: Fraunces (headlines), Bricolage Grotesque (body), Barlow Condensed (labels/UI)
- **Label font size** — raised from 14px to 16px to match the stated mobile minimum text rule
- **`button-tertiary`** — added to YAML `components` block (was prose-only)
- **Input token** — added `borderWidth: "1px"` and `focusBorderColor: "{colors.primary}"` to the `input` component token
- **Max-width** — corrected in prose: 1200px → 1240px (matches `+layout.svelte`)
- **Input border-radius** — corrected in prose: "4px on inputs" → "8px on inputs" (matches `{rounded.md}` token)
- **Prose descriptions** — updated color/component prose to match the new tokens

### PR #105 — seam refactor (10 unresolved threads)

- **`prompt-compiler-seam/mock.ts`** — added `_input` parameter to `compile()` so the signature matches the contract (`(input: PromptCompilerInput) => Promise<CompiledPrompt>`)
- **`prompt-compiler-seam/test.ts`** — removed `as never` cast; `promptCompilerInputFixture` is already `PromptCompilerInput` and the mock now accepts it directly
- **`prompt-compiler-seam/fixtures.ts`** — exported fault fixtures as `unknown`; cast deferred to `getCompiledPromptFixture` usage site only
- **`gallery-store-seam/test.ts`** — strengthened `listRecent` limit test with an ordering assertion (`['r3', 'r2']`) so sort-behavior regressions can't slip through as long as the count is still 2
- **`gallery-store-seam/mock.ts`** — corrected header comment; mock uses in-memory state, not fixture seeding
- **`gallery-store-seam/fixtures.ts`** — exported `galleryRecordFaultFixture` as `unknown`; validators already accept `unknown` so no cast needed at test sites

## Test plan

- [ ] All 8 seam contract tests pass (`vitest run src/lib/seams/gallery-store-seam/test.ts src/lib/seams/prompt-compiler-seam/test.ts`)
- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] `design.md` tokens match `+layout.svelte` CSS variables
